Subject: Need midterm capacity top-up and how it invoices

Marcus —

We’re seeing a sharp uptick in inference consumption this month and need to add midterm capacity while keeping our billing aligned to our existing annual term (expires 2027-12-31). Procurement asked me to reach out for:

- A firm price for a temporary top-up (approx. +40% monthly tokens) for the next 6 months
- Options to co-term or split invoices so the additional spend is reconciled to our annual PO
- Any discount for committing to the top-up or for moving to an annualized add-on

Can you share options and an indication of lead time to get an amendment or PO in place? We may need SOC 2 evidence for the finance team but that can follow.

Thanks,
Alyssa Park
Director, Platform AI
LuminaHealth

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the heads up — glad to hear the product is scaling. High level we can offer two practical paths; I attached a short options sheet (Lumina_Topup_Options.pdf). Summary below:

Option A — Temporary top-up (fastest)
- Add a 6-month top-up for the committed units you outlined
- One-time charge at start of top-up, pro-rated to the month we start
- 5% uplift discount on the incremental units for speed
- Amendment processed in ~3 business days once we have PO

Option B — Annualize and co-term (preferred for predictable billing)
- Convert the top-up into an annual add-on, co-term with your 2027-12-31 expiry
- 8% discount on the incremental volume in exchange for the co-term commitment
- Invoice split option available (we can invoice the incremental as quarterly installments)
- Timeline: draft amendment in ~5 business days + standard legal review

Quick clarifying Qs for procurement: do you need the top-up to appear on the same PO number as the base contract, or can it come on a separate PO referencing the base? Also let me know if you prefer a one-time invoice vs quarterly installments — we’ll price both paths in the formal amendment.

I’ll loop in Kimberly (pricing) and Laura (billing) to confirm final invoices and discount structure.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
